bio.text: Pete Aguilar represents California's 33rd Congressional District in the U.S. House and chairs the House Democratic Caucus in the 119th Congress.
He was born in Fontana, California, in 1979, and earned bachelor's degrees in government and business administration from the University of Redlands in 2001.
He was appointed to the Redlands City Council in 2006, served until 2014, and was Mayor of Redlands from 2010 to 2014.
He lives in Redlands and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
